To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

lymphocytes can stimulate expression of the 2 key enzymes of the 5-LO pathway, namely 5-lipoxy-genase and its activating factor, in monocytes, and they do so via the release of 2 key cytokines, GM-CSF and interleukin-3.

lymphocytes can stimulate expression of 2 proteins, 5-lipoxygense and its activator, in monocytes, via the release, in response to activation by lectins, of the cytokines granulocyte macrophase colony-stimulating factors (GM-CSF) and interleukin-3 (IL-3), which act synergistically.
monocyte 5-lipoxygease expression is upregulated by GM-CSF and/or IL-3, which are released by lymphocytes in vitro.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms by which lymphocytes and monocytes interact to modulate the expression of the 12/15 lipoxygenase pathway of arachidonic acid metabolism in monocytes and macrophages.
the role of lymphocyte-derived cytokines in regulating the expression of 2 key enzymes of the 5-LOX pathway, 5-LO and FLAP, in monocytes.
the role of the 5-Lipoxygenase (5-LO) pathway in inflammation and its modulation by cytokines and growth factors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
lymphocytes can modulate monocyte 5-lipoxygense expression by the release of soluble cytokines.
the 5-lipooxygenase pathway in human monocytes is under the influence of lymphocytes via soluble factors, primarily IL-3 and GM-CSF.
the 5-lipooxygenase system is regulated by lymphocytes in vitro via the release of granulocyte macro-phage colony-stimulatng factor (GM-CSF) and interleukin (IL) 3.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the 5-lipooxygenase pathway in human monocytes can be regulated, over a period days, by soluble factors released by lymphocytes, primarily GM-CSFs and IL-3, and that the 5- lipooxygenase pathway can also be regulated by GM-CSF and/or IL-3 in monocytes.
the expression of the 4-lipoxygenase enzyme in human monocytes can be upregulated by the presence of activated lymphocytes in the culture system.
lymphocytes can influence the expression of 4-lipoxygenase, 5-lipoxygenease, and cyclo-oxygenase in monocyte-macrophages.
The main takeaway from our work is that
lymphocytes can modulate monocyte function by the secretion of cytokines that can be detected in their supernatants.
GM-CSF and interleukin-3 (IL-3) can regulate expression of 5-Lipoxygenase and the 5-Lipoxyenase activating protein (FLAP).
lymphocytes can influence the expression of 1LOX and 5LOX-activating protein in monocytes.
